scheme_name: Scheme For Assistance For Start Ups/ Innovation
other_conditions: Startups must have an innovative idea or concept and be recommended by an approved Nodal Institution
Entities formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business are not considered startups
Startups receiving incentives under any other Gujarat startup scheme are ineligible, except those under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP)

Nodal Institutions must be a university, government‑approved/affiliated/recognized educational institution, incubation centre, PSU, R&D institution, or private establishment operating in Gujarat, registered under the Companies Act‑2013 Section 8 as a non‑profit company, with separate spaces and full‑time employees
Mentors must be resource persons registered under this scheme and associated/recommended by the Nodal Institution
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹30 lakh seed support, monthly sustenance allowance, interest subsidy and other financial assistance to eligible startups and supporting Nodal Institutions.
